'''Aburrey Auditory Chip''' is a {{gear|4|Kit}}gear item.

{{Item description|Designed by Triglava Armoury and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.|A piece of novel protective equipment modified for the work environment of the Aburrey Quarry. 
When exploring the unknown, proper sound insulation and hearing protection are extremely important. This chip can effectively help the wearer determine if they are suffering from auditory hallucinations.}}
